needed.evidence: The footway is an informal trodden strip rather than a purpose-built sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a formal, paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space.

needed.evidence: There is no designated footway for pedestrians on the right side.
needed.suggestion: Install a purpose-built sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The informal path is uneven and contains debris.
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the walking area on the left to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are crossing the road in the carriageway without any designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe and visible point for people to cross the road.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along this urban stretch of road.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for all users at night.
